newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austria's Klestil in hospital, cancels trip.
newsitem.headline: Austria's Klestil in hospital, cancels trip.

text.p: Austrian President Thomas Klestil was admitted to hospital on Friday with a lung infection and had to cancel a planned two-day official visit to Germany, daily Die Presse reported on Saturday.
It quoted a presidential spokesman as saying Klestil, 64, had to spend "several days" in a Vienna hospital.
Klestil was scheduled to visit the German state of Bavaria on Tuesday and Wednesday where he was to meet German President Roman Herzog.
